A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the brain may compensate for the effects of sleep loss by increasing its activation in some regions, but that the effects of sleep deprivation may not be uniform across the brain.

sleep deprivation leads to increased activation in some brain regions, particularly those involved in attention.
sleep is not just a restorative process.
